detailed_descriptions.en: The official soundtrack for Cult of the Lamb explores the highs and lows of starting a cult. Build your cult listening to chilled beats, and go to battle empowered by bouncy bass, punchy drums, and soaring distorted vocals. Music composed and produced by River Boy.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The official soundtrack for Cult of the Lamb explores the highs and lows of starting a cult. Build your cult listening to chilled beats, and go to battle empowered by bouncy bass, punchy drums, and soaring distorted vocals.
